scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.verify:supabase: node scripts/verify-supabase-migration-ledger.mjs && node scripts/verify-supabase-operational-config.mjs && node scripts/test-supabase-operational-config.mjs && node scripts/verify-supabase-storage-policies.mjs && node scripts/test-supabase-storage-policies.mjs && node scripts/verify-phase1-linked-persona-access.mjs && node --test scripts/test-phase1-linked-persona-access.mjs
